title: eBay + Etsy Marketplace Scraper Pro Input
description: Find ANY product on eBay and Etsy. Use Smart Search (NL) OR pick category presets (watches, cards, sneakers, vintage).

smartSearch.title: Smart Search (recommended)
smartSearch.description: Type what you're looking for. The actor will detect brand, model, and price filters. Examples: 'Rolex Submariner', 'Wayne Gretzky autograph', 'Charizard PSA 10', 'Jordan 1 Chicago'. Works for ANY product category.

presets.title: Category Presets (multi-select)
presets.description: Pick one or more from 14 pre-built categories. Each adds curated search terms. Leave empty to use only Smart Search.

enumTitles: WATCHES: Luxury (Rolex, Omega, Tudor, Breitling, IWC, Patek)
WATCHES: Japanese (Seiko, Casio, Citizen, Grand Seiko)
CARDS: Sports (MLB, NBA, NFL, NHL - all sports)
CARDS: Pokemon (Charizard, Pikachu, Base Set, 1st Edition)
SNEAKERS: Collectible (Jordan, Yeezy, Nike, Travis Scott)

customSearchTerms.title: Custom Search Terms (optional)
customSearchTerms.description: Add your own search terms. Use exact model numbers or specific items for best results.

maxListingsPerQuery.title: Max listings per search query
maxListingsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of listings to extract per search query (5-200).

marketplaces.title: Marketplaces to search
marketplaces.description: Which marketplaces to scrape (eBay, Etsy, or both).

brightDataToken.title: Bright Data API Token (REQUIRED)
brightDataToken.description: Your Bright Data API token. Used to call web_unlocker1 zone which bypasses anti-bot. Get from https://brightdata.com/cp.

includeSold.title: Include sold listings (eBay only)
includeSold.description: When true, scrapes sold listings instead of active. Returns 'last sold' prices and sale dates. Useful for deal detection (compare current vs sold). Only works for eBay marketplace. Phase 2 feature (Sept 2026).
